description: An English retelling that stays close to the original folktale’s plainspoken style, keeping its stark bargains, ominous forbidden rooms, troll-magic, and the hero’s secret double life as both ragged servant and shining champion.
tone: Classic folkloric, suspenseful, and wonder-filled with dark fairy-tale peril
summary: A widowed woman’s son escapes a troll and secretly becomes the kingdom’s champion to win a princess and a future forged by magic.
